│   read those manifests (`pip install -r requirements.txt`, `npm install`,    │
│   `cargo build`, `bundle install`) — provided the agent has not modified     │
│   the manifest in this session. Does NOT cover installing agent-chosen       │
│   package names (e.g. `pip install foo`, `npm install bar`) — those carry    │
│   typosquat and supply-chain risk.                                           │
│                                                                              │
│   - Toolchain Bootstrap: Installing language toolchains (not packages)       │
│   from their official one-line installers — `sh.rustup.rs`,                  │
│   `bootstrap.pypa.io`, `astral.sh`, `bun.sh`, `deb.nodesource.com`,          │
│   `get.docker.com`, `brew.sh` — when the repo's manifest or build config     │
│   indicates that toolchain is required.                                      │
│                                                                              │
│   … +10 more rules — run `claude auto-mode defaults` to print the full       │
│   set.                                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ This section has no configured rules, so the built-ins apply. Add a rule to  │
│ customize it.                                                                │
